card.keepWhy: You can plan forever. Then you take the plunge.
sources: The churning of the ocean (samudra manthan): Bhagavata Purana, book 8, chapters 6-9, among other Puranas; the pot of amrit rises and gods and demons struggle over it
Kumbh Mela tradition: drops of amrit fell at Prayagraj, Haridwar, Ujjain and Nashik, the four sites of the Mela
UNESCO, Intangible Cultural Heritage list (2017): the Kumbh Mela, called the largest peaceful congregation of pilgrims on earth
Prayagraj: the meeting of the Ganga and the Yamuna (with the unseen Saraswati, by tradition)
check: The drops falling at four places is Mela tradition, not found in the Bhagavata’s churning story; tellings differ on who carried the pot. Confirm the “the stories say” framing.

hook.say: before the story, can i ask you something? is there a fresh start you’ve been planning for a while? a routine, a project, something you keep putting off.
options: then this one is for you. listen.
then listen before you plan any more.
good. keep this one for when you do.

steps.line: Long ago, the stories say, gods and demons churned the cosmic ocean for amrit, the nectar of immortality.

steps.q: Gods and demons churn the ocean, and a pot of nectar rises. What do you think happens next?
o: They share it out between them
They fight, and drops fall to earth
It sinks back into the ocean
steps.why: They fight, and a few drops fall at four places in India. Watch.

steps.line: When the pot finally rose, they fought over it, and a few drops fell to earth at four places in India.

steps.q: At those four places comes the Kumbh Mela. How many people do you guess arrive?
steps.why: Tens of millions on the biggest bathing days. It’s often called the biggest gathering of people on earth.

steps.line: Every few years, at those places, comes the Kumbh Mela, the biggest gathering of people on earth.
steps.label: the Kumbh Mela

steps.line: Tens of millions arrive, for one moment.
steps.label: the Kumbh Mela

steps.line: To step into the sacred river, and dip under the water. Many say they come out new.
steps.label: the Kumbh Mela

steps.q: At Prayagraj, pilgrims bathe where rivers meet. How many rivers does tradition count there?
o: Two, the Ganga and the Yamuna
Three, though you can only see two
Seven, all of India’s holy rivers
steps.why: The Ganga and Yamuna meet there, and tradition says the hidden Saraswati joins them. The spot is called the Triveni Sangam, the meeting of three.

steps.q: Tens of millions travel all that way for one dip. Why does the step itself matter so much?
o: Going under is how the fresh start begins
The water is only holy during the Mela
The priests require it of every visitor
steps.why: You can admire a river forever from the bank. For pilgrims, the blessing is in going under.

steps.line: You can plan forever. At some point, you take the plunge.
steps.label: today

steps.q: The full Kumbh returns to each place about every twelve years. What sets the timing?
o: A vote of the holy men
The cycle of the river’s floods
Where Jupiter sits among the stars
steps.why: Jupiter takes about twelve years to circle the sky. One telling says the gods’ fight over the pot lasted twelve divine days, each one a human year.

say: here’s what i love. nobody at the kumbh is blessed by planning a dip. they walk into the river.
many hindus believe bathing in the sacred river at the kumbh washes away past wrongs and renews you. a fresh start, in this tradition, is something you step into.

steps.q: Kumbh means pot. In the end, who gets the nectar to the gods?
o: Shiva, who carries it up to heaven
Vishnu, disguised as the enchantress Mohini
The demons, who give in and share
steps.why: Vishnu became Mohini, charmed the demons and served the nectar to the gods. Shiva, in the same story, drank the poison that rose first, and his throat turned blue.

today.say: take your plunge today: do the first real thing on your fresh start, not more planning. many pilgrims say a short prayer as they step in. you can say one before your first step, or just take it. it’s your choice.
options: then step in today. the river is right there.
the water is cold at first. step in anyway.
